faculty_override_note: The official four-semester map is the default; the official five-semester map is an alternate lighter-load pathway. DegreeWorks and faculty advisement remain authoritative.
sequence_notes: BIO 210 precedes BIO 220; the current shared Pathways model does not attach prerequisites to derived choice-group members.
PSY 100 should be completed in the first semester because it is the prerequisite for later Psychology courses.
Three Psychology electives totaling at least 9 credits are required.
PSY 265 requires PSY 100 and two completed 200-level Psychology courses; the current prerequisite model records PSY 100 and the planner keeps PSY 265 late in the sequence.
A Writing Intensive course is required for graduation.
